analysisRuntime.promptTitle: An analysis runtime component is available
analysisRuntime.featureUpdateBody: This feature requires downloading or updating the {title} analysis component (about {size}). Features already supported remain available.
analysisRuntime.promptBody: This computer can download the {title} analysis component (about {size}) for supported analysis features.
analysisRuntime.promptHint: If GitHub is unreachable from the current network, try enabling a VPN or make sure the system proxy / PAC is applied to Track Studio.
analysisRuntime.downloadInProgressTitleGeneric: The analysis runtime is being prepared
analysisRuntime.downloadInProgressHint: The analysis runtime is currently downloading or extracting. This feature stays unavailable until it finishes.
analysisRuntime.downloadInProgressProgressHint: Check the Downloads card in the bottom-right corner for progress.
analysisRuntime.unsupportedHint: This computer does not currently support the analysis component required by this feature.
analysisRuntime.manifestUnavailableHint: Unable to fetch the analysis runtime manifest. This is usually caused by network, GitHub access, or proxy configuration issues.
analysisRuntime.downloadFailedHint: The analysis component download failed. The requested feature is currently unavailable.
analysisRuntime.horizontalBlockedHint: The current analysis component does not support dual-track horizontal browse. Download a compatible component first.
analysisRuntime.stemBlockedHint: The current analysis component does not support the Stem workspace. Download a compatible component first.
analysisRuntime.trackAnalysisBlockedHint: Beat grid analysis requires the analysis runtime component, which is not ready yet. Nothing was submitted this time.
